title: The settlement export is silently dropping most of a merchant's transactions
details:
Northwind reconciled our settlement export against their own records and found it short.

Their account has 8 settled transactions for the period. The export produced 3 of them. No error, no
warning — the file is just short, and it has been short for at least six weeks.

We reproduced it on a test merchant: with 30 transactions where every third one is settled, the export
returns the first few and then stops. The rows it does return are correct and in the right order; it is
the ones after a certain point that never appear.

Merchants whose transactions are ALL settled get a complete export, which is why our own reconciliation
checks never caught it — the test merchants we use are all fully settled.

The export appears to give up early rather than paging to the end of the data.
